definitions.explanation: Having lived or existed for only a short time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{見|み}た{目|め}→見た目：14110_mitame⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{若|わか}い。
{若|わか}い⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}した→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧。
examples.english: I traveled a lot when I was young.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い⟦{頃|ころ}→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{運動|うんどう}していた→運動：00821_undou⟧。
examples.english: When I was young, I exercised every day.

examples.english: The company has many young employees, so the atmosphere is bright and lively.

notes:
{若|わか}い is an i-adjective meaning "young," typically describing people but also applicable to organizations or things.

FORMS:
- Adverb: ⟦{若|わか}く→若い：00823_wakai⟧ (⟦{若|わか}く→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧ - to look young)
- Noun form: ⟦{若|わか}さ→若さ：20335_wakasa⟧ (youth, youthfulness)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {若|わか}い⟦{頃|ころ}→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧/⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧: when (someone was) young
- {若|わか}い⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧/⟦{者|もの}→者：12734_mono⟧: young person
- {若|わか}い⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧: younger generation
- ⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{若|わか}い: still young

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧: young person, youth
- ⟦{若返|わかがえ}る→若返る：14003_wakagaeru⟧: to become younger, rejuvenate

USAGE:
Unlike English "young," {若|わか}い is rarely used for very small children - ⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧ or specific age terms are preferred. {若|わか}い often implies teenage to early 30s.
